How it works

Not a reseller. Your robotics integrator.

Robot sales, deployment, staff training, and nationwide service — one partner from the first demo to the last spare part.

  1. 01

    Walk your floor

    A free 30-minute on-site walkthrough. We map your workflow, measure the space, and shortlist robots that fit the way you actually operate.

  2. 02

    Map & deploy

    Facility mapping and integration with your elevators, PMS, and POS. Install and programming handled by RobotLAB technicians — not a courier drop-off.

  3. 03

    Train your team

    Hands-on staff onboarding until your team runs the robot without us. Playbooks, cheat-sheets, and refresher sessions included.

  4. 04

    Keep it running

    20+ local service centers, 24/7 support, loaner units if downtime tops 48 hours, and 97% average fleet uptime. Service is the product.

Questions & answers

About RobotLAB.

The questions we get most often. Always open — no dropdowns. If you want more, our contact team answers same-day.

  1. What does RobotLAB actually do?

    RobotLAB is America's largest commercial robotics integrator. We sell, deploy, train, monitor, and service commercial service robots from 22+ manufacturers — including Pudu, Bear Robotics, Gausium, LG, SoftBank, and Temi. Founded in 2007 in Dallas, we've delivered $120M+ in robots to 5,000+ businesses across all 50 U.S. states and shipped to 100+ countries & states.

  2. What industries does RobotLAB serve?

    60+ industries with active deployments. The biggest verticals are hotels, restaurants, healthcare, assisted living, warehouses, and K-12 schools. We also deploy in airports, multifamily, gyms, retail, government, manufacturing, car dealerships, and entertainment venues.

  3. What capabilities do RobotLAB's robots have?

    Across our fleet we cover: autonomous cleaning (270M+ sq ft cleaned), commercial delivery (213M+ tasks), cooking, customer service, security patrol, UV-C disinfection, wayfinding, brand ambassador, agricultural drones, plus STEM, VR/AR, coding-and-AI, fabrication-lab, innovation-lab, and AI-lab capabilities for education.

  4. How much does a commercial robot from RobotLAB cost?

    Entry-level robots like Whiz vacuum start at $9,800. Mid-tier delivery robots like BellaBot Pro start at $16,000. Commercial scrubbers like Gausium Scrubber 50 start at $18,900. RaaS subscriptions start at $499/month all-inclusive.

  5. What's the typical payback period for a commercial robot?

    Delivery robots in restaurants: 8–12 months. Cleaning robots in hotels: 9–14 months. Bussing robots: 7–10 months. Warehouse AGVs: 12–18 months. UV-C disinfection in healthcare: 12–18 months plus avoided infection costs.

  6. How do I buy, lease, or subscribe to a robot from RobotLAB?

    Three paths: outright purchase (Net 30 for commercial accounts), equipment lease ($1 buyout, Section 179 eligible, 36–60 month terms), or RaaS — Robots-as-a-Service ($499+/mo all-inclusive, 36-month standard term, convert-to-purchase any time after month 12).

  7. Does RobotLAB service the robots after deployment?

    Yes. 20+ local service centers nationwide. Standard service plan ($199/mo per unit) includes 24/7 support, software updates, parts and labor, loaner if downtime over 48h, quarterly health checks, fleet monitoring, and annual on-site visit. Average fleet uptime 97%.

  8. Which robot manufacturers does RobotLAB carry?

    22 manufacturers: Pudu (US-exclusive), Bear Robotics, Gausium, LG Business Solutions, SoftBank (Pepper/NAO/Whiz — US-exclusive), Temi, Keenon, CenoBots, Cleanfix, UBTech, Cyngn, Vision Aerial, AgileX, Dobot, Unitree, Niryo, Blueye, Dremel, Botinkit, Firia Labs, R-Zero/UVD.

  9. How do I get started with RobotLAB?

    Use the finder at the top of robotlab.com — tell us your industry, region, and goal, and we'll shortlist robots that fit. Or request a free on-site demo — same-day response, walkthrough within 5 business days. Or call 1-87-RobotLAB Mon–Fri 8a–6p CT.
